headline: Blackwing Lair in 28:29, the guild's fastest clear by four and a half minutes

mvp.headline: the most damage on four bosses, parse 90 or better on all eight
why: First on Razorgore (parse 99), Vaelastrasz (2494/s), Flamegor (98) and Chromaggus (103k), second on Nefarian
Average parse 95 across the raid, no deaths
Also the most damage on Sulfuron in Molten Core earlier the same night

also.text: 5 Tranquilizing Shots on Flamegor and Chromaggus, and parse 99 on Firemaw and Ebonroc
11 Black afflictions cleansed on Chromaggus, the most, then parse 99 on Nefarian
7 interrupts, the most in the raid

overview: Eight kills on eight pulls in 28:29. The guild's best was 33:00 and a usual night is 47:25. Razorgore (0:20), Vaelastrasz (0:26) and Firemaw (0:36) are new guild bests, and Chromaggus (1:15) equals the old one.
Five boss deaths, three of them one raider: Roguina on Broodlord, Firemaw and Ebonroc. Zuzul went to Flame Buffet on Firemaw and Salma to Shadow Flame five seconds into Nefarian.
World buffs grew during the raid: 21 with Rallying Cry on Vaelastrasz, 35 by Firemaw.

wentWell.text: Firemaw in 0:36, a guild best by seven seconds, with a parse median of 95 and half the usual Flame Buffet stacks.
All four of Flamegor's Frenzies tranquilized, by Speldosan and Emanuelxxion.
Razorgore in 0:20, a guild best, Thornhild and Wizness parse 99.
Nefarian in 1:30 with a parse median of 85 against a usual 66. 6 Fear Wards (Künigünde 3).

notes.text: 0:26, a guild best (was 0:27), no deaths. Raid damage 38.4k a second, the highest of the night. One Burning Adrenaline, on Speldosan.
0:46 (median 0:50). Roguina died to his Cleave at 0:23. Gertggs top at 1459/s.
0:36, a guild best (was 0:43, median 1:40). Flame Buffet killed Roguina at 0:27 and Zuzul at 0:35. Shadow Flame hit 3, against a usual 11.
0:49 (median 1:15). Roguina died to Shadow Flame at 0:39. Shadow of Ebonroc on Birkler 3 times and Wellan once.
0:46 (median 1:04), no deaths, 4 of 4 Frenzies tranquilized. Fire Nova hits a bit over the usual rate.
1:15, equal to the guild best, no deaths. 4 of 5 Frenzies tranquilized (Speldosan 3 shots, Emanuelxxion 2). 58 afflictions cleansed, Orbywan 11.
Ignite Flesh did 40k, all of it to four players: Whorm 18.7k and Skoomael 11k took more of the breath than Macharius, who was tanking.
1:30 (best 1:23, median 2:25). Salma took five Shadow Flames and died at 0:05, the only death. Gertggs 140k and Thornhild 137k.
